episodes.synopsis: Shinpei returns home for his friend Ushio's funeral. She apparently drowned, but something is off.
episodes.title: Goodbye, Summer Days

episodes.synopsis: To find out the truth about Ushio's death, Shinpei and Mio head to Hiruko.
episodes.title: Shadows

episodes.synopsis: After being stabbed by Mio's shadow, Shinpei regains consciousness at the docks on July 22nd.
episodes.title: Drifting Ashore

episodes.synopsis: Ushio's shadow appears before Shinpei at the summer festival.
episodes.title: Jamais-vu

episodes.synopsis: A giant shadow massacres everyone at the Hitogashima Summer Festival and engulfs the whole island.
episodes.title: Maelstrom

episodes.synopsis: Hizuru Minakata, the woman on the ferry, returns to Hitogashima Island hoping to solve a mystery.
episodes.title: Orbital Resonance

episodes.synopsis: In order to defeat the Kobayakawa's shadows, Shinpei and Hizuru join forces with Nezu.
episodes.title: Deadly Enemy

episodes.synopsis: Mio's shadow appears before Shinpei and threatens him with a knife.
episodes.title: Memento

episodes.synopsis: In a video, Ushio and her shadow recount their encounter up to the moment the video is recorded.
episodes.title: My Flowing Tears

episodes.synopsis: Shinpei gains clues on Mount Takanosu since Ushio and her shadow had gone there.
episodes.title: Into the Darkness

episodes.synopsis: Ushio, Sou and Shinpei are surrounded by shadows.
episodes.title: Dinner Time

episodes.synopsis: Tokiko, Sou's younger sister, reveals she has been offering corpses as food to Hiruko.
episodes.title: Bloody Night

episodes.synopsis: It is the fifth July 22nd for Shinpei. Hizuru takes time to process that Shinpei is a time traveler.
episodes.title: Friends

episodes.synopsis: Shinpei finds himself in Hizuru's memories from fourteen years ago.
episodes.title: To Be/Not to Be

episodes.synopsis: Heine, who loops like Shinpei, realizes the pattern of behavior when a new loop begins.
episodes.title: Lights Camera Action

episodes.synopsis: Mio proposes to turn the shadows into allies.
episodes.title: Original

episodes.synopsis: Shinpei hears about Shide's identity from Sou's father, Director of Hishigata Clinic.
episodes.title: Determination

episodes.synopsis: A seventy-year-old photograph reveals the truth.
episodes.title: Face to Face

episodes.synopsis: Karikiri and Heine strike. Mio and Hizuru learn of Ushio's death.
episodes.title: Made in Black

episodes.synopsis: Hizuru and Karikiri face off, while Gil and Rose enter the fray.
episodes.title: All is (not) Lost.

episodes.synopsis: Shinpei despairs over Hizuru's death. However, hope is on the horizon.
episodes.title: Shinpei Ajiro's Longest Day

episodes.synopsis: Ushio fully comes back to life. Shinpei heads to Hiruko's grotto.
episodes.title: Return

episodes.synopsis: After slicing down Heine, Shide brings Shinpei and Ushio to her home.
episodes.title: Everlasting Night

episodes.synopsis: After a fierce battle, Shinpei takes the place of an exhausted Ushio and confronts Shide.
episodes.title: Summertime Re-Rendering

episodes.synopsis: Shide is gone and Ushio's final iteration must vanish. Shinpei comes to on the morning of July 22nd.
episodes.title: [I'm Home]
